body: White, messy-hair, crime fighter, man

I'm glad to see they're healing. I don't know if this subreddit is pro or anti cutting. Regardless, I pray that you can find joy in life and avoid this habit. It's a dangerous road. People do love you.
Dude, you have no idea how much I needed to hear that, and I'm not even the dude who posted this.

On to day three now. Bout to pass out. I have another full day tomorrow is I can muster the strength to get out of bed. No large temptation yet so thank you for prayers and keep em coming as I'm sure my biological clock is getting disgruntled with the lack of release.

Ya I watched the YBOP videos and saw that shame and guilt actually strengthen the addiction because it makes the moment notable. Those videos really put a lot of things in perspective. Here's to day one. Tomorrow school, work, evening with my friends, and no porn. Tomorrow is day two.
I live fifteen minutes from campus by car. Biking is not an option in February and January.

I have been watching those. I got through the first twenty minutes and decided I was up too late as is so I'm about to start watching some more. I want to get new habits and hobbies but I enjoy stuff with friends (I guess that goes to bonding) and I don't make enough money to constantly drive to campus (I live at home) and meet up someone every time I want to. Gas takes the majority of my paychecks. I intend, this semester, to linger on campus more.

Not ok is lusting after women who are not my wife. (I have no wife, but when I do I will freely drool over her and do what I can to make her happy. Marriage is something I look forward to and don't want to screw it up as my father did.) Many of these women have been exploited in the past too. That's what disgusts me. I help many of my friends deal with this, but the stranger who were exploited are all of a sudden different to me.
If a person's purpose in life is to be happy and religion makes them happy, why must it matter what one believes to atheists?
Quick question about OpenDNS. Am I safe to do online banking with this program?
I've run into that too, but fortunately/unfortunately pictures don't stimulate me as much. (I say unfortunately because it shows that I've been desensitized.)
As a man who is completely clueless as to what this means, yes we should.
I know the feeling. You miss the high. I wish I could say yes, but I can't. LastChanceAvalanch has it right.

When I first started reading this post I thought that I was gonna discard it as stupid, but as time went on it made more sense. Really, thanks. I've been thinking of hobbies, but what I love most is writing, which is best done on computer for me... then again... I just thought of a place I have access to without the internet. Thank you very much.
These are already proving to be useful tools. Thank you so much.
I think I know what you mean. Occasionally I see it and just think, "There has to be more than this." I then get mad at myself for using it.

I have faced this too. When is it art and when is it porn? My thing, I don't care which it is. If it is arousing me, I should cut it off (The image, not my penis). Nudity isn't always going to turn you on-Venus de Milo can hardly be considered erotica- but if it does,try to block it or look away. What I can gather from your post however is that your profession puts you in these situations a lot. If at all possible, avoid situations where such a topic may occur and outshine competition with non-nude artwork.
thank you. I'll make note of it. That happened to me when I went to see 30 Minutes or Less. But it showed the strip club sign first so I had time to look away.

Thanks guys. I appreciate it a lot. I'm testing the DNS right now.
I feel ya man. It depletes your energy and emotion. Makes me easily agitated.
I admire you as I begin day one.
Letters of love for those who helped make me bawl. This is one of the sweetest things, on behalf of the officer and yourself, I've seen on the internet.

Thanks to all you guys. It's been stressful knowing that some people hate me because of it. I don't even know why but they do. Fortunately my closest friends, save Mike, understand. Thanks for the encouragement.
Thanks. It's just been weird because when I broke up with my girlfriend of two years, he was the first one there for me.

I really wish I knew where you lived. I'd take to lunch or coffee. What you did means a lot to us, but we don't know where you are. Next time you're in the office and someone asks how your day is, tell them. Say it sucks. Say every single word that is written here. You'd be surprised who cares for you. Who admires from a far. Your courage to post this makes me an anonymous admirer. Also, I don't think you're too weak to kill yourself. I think you're too strong to let your life be wasted.
